ServiceAdministratif.hero_subtitle: CVs in the expected format, tailored letters, professional translations, IRCC forms completed with rigor, printing in Bangui. Your documents are ready to submit — not rewritten by the recipient.
ServiceAdministratif.hero_trust_before: Free quote · Full confidentiality · A question?
ServiceAdministratif.wa_question: Hello Nexus, I have a question about the Administrative service.
ServiceAdministratif.intro_before: An official document leaves no room for approximation. A comma, a format, an omission can make the difference between
ServiceAdministratif.intro_highlight: a favorable decision and a refusal
ServiceAdministratif.scope_subtitle: Four structured steps, from scoping the deliverable to the final review.
ServiceAdministratif.scope_item1_desc: Identifying the format, language and exact conventions expected by the recipient.
ServiceAdministratif.scope_item2_desc: CV, letter, certificate: produced according to the standards of the target jurisdiction or institution.
ServiceAdministratif.scope_item3_desc: French-English, French-Arabic: certified translations where applicable.
ServiceAdministratif.scope_item4_desc: Two quality passes before delivery. No typos, no inconsistencies.
ServiceAdministratif.result_subtitle: Documents ready to submit, with no last-minute corrections.
ServiceAdministratif.result_item1_desc: Canadian CV for Canada, Europass for the EU, consular format for visas, etc.
ServiceAdministratif.result_item2_desc: Tone, style and terminology adjusted to the recipient and context.
ServiceAdministratif.result_item3_desc: Recognized translations, signatures and stamps according to official procedure.
ServiceAdministratif.result_item4_desc: No correction for you to make at the last minute.
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_subtitle: We work with rigor on every document. This requirement is part of our professional commitment.
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_oui_title: This service is for people who
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_oui_1: Want a clean document, compliant with the expected format (Canadian CV, formal letter, IRCC form) without approximation
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_oui_2: Agree to provide accurate information and answer our scoping questions
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_oui_3: Are ready to validate a final review before delivery
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_non_title: This service is not for people who
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_non_1: Are looking for a generic template copied without adaptation to your profile — that is not our method
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_non_2: Want to sign an official application on your behalf — for legal reasons, the signature must be that of the applicant
ServiceAdministratif.pourqui_non_3: Expect a document written in a few minutes without scoping — every deliverable goes through review
ServiceAdministratif.metho_subtitle: From the initial brief to delivery of the document, every step is scoped and tracked.
ServiceAdministratif.metho_01_desc: You complete our form (type of service, target format, language, urgency) or book an appointment. We collect the necessary documents.
ServiceAdministratif.metho_02_desc: A Nexus advisor defines the exact scope and proposes a fixed quote and delivery time. No work is undertaken before validation.
ServiceAdministratif.metho_03_desc: Drafting, translation or completion handled by a qualified team member. Codes of the target document (Canadian CV, IRCC...) mastered.
ServiceAdministratif.metho_04_desc: Systematic proofreading before sending. Digital delivery (PDF + editable) and/or printing at the Bangui office, depending on your choice.
ServiceAdministratif.metho_cta_subtitle: Quote within a few hours. Delivery time announced before production.
ServiceAdministratif.presta_subtitle: Each family has its codes and deliverables. The quote specifies the exact scope based on your need.
ServiceAdministratif.presta_cv_desc: Canadian, European or African CV format. Tailored cover letter (studies, employment, visa, scholarship). Scoping interview if needed.
ServiceAdministratif.presta_trad_desc: Professional translation of short and official documents. For sworn translations (courts, certain consulates), referral to a certified translator.
ServiceAdministratif.presta_form_desc: Filling out IRCC, France-Visas, consulate and university applications. Full preparation, line-by-line guidance. Signature: yours.
ServiceAdministratif.presta_print_desc: Color or B&W printing, binding, lamination, high-quality scanning, digitization and electronic delivery of complete files.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_subtitle: Quality does not come from a beautiful template, but from content relevance for the actual recipient.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_1_desc: Canadian CV ≠ French CV. IRCC ≠ France-Visas. We adapt systematically.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_2_desc: If your information is incomplete, a short conversation is enough to reconstruct a clean profile.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_3_desc: No document is delivered without proofreading. No avoidable mistakes, no inconsistencies.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_4_desc: French, English. For sworn translations, referral to a certified translator.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_5_desc: Documents and information strictly confidential. No redistribution or reuse.
ServiceAdministratif.qualite_6_desc: Announced deadline = delivered deadline. If at risk, you are warned in advance, not after.
ServiceAdministratif.cas_title: Here is how it works in practice.
ServiceAdministratif.cas_1_desc: About thirty minutes of interview to reconstruct the profile, identification of experiences to highlight, formatting to strict Canadian standards (length, vocabulary, organization), proofreading and delivery as PDF + editable version.
ServiceAdministratif.cas_1_result: Outcome: clean CV submitted to 3 universities, application taken seriously from the initial sort.
ServiceAdministratif.cas_2_title: Preparation of a Canada study permit application
ServiceAdministratif.cas_2_desc: Precise list of documents, line-by-line completion with the applicant, translation of 3 documents, cross-form consistency checks, support up to signature and submission by the applicant.
ServiceAdministratif.cas_2_result: Outcome: clean application, submitted with no back-and-forth with the visa officer.
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_subtitle: A clear scope avoids misunderstandings and protects both the deliverable's quality and legal compliance.
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_no_1: Sign or submit an official application on your behalf
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_no_2: Guarantee acceptance of a visa, an admission or an application
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_no_3: Issue a sworn translation — referral to a certified translator
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_yes_1: A document compliant with the format expected by the recipient
ServiceAdministratif.engagement_yes_3: A deadline announced in advance and respected
ServiceAdministratif.tarif_subtitle: Fixed quote per service, communicated before production.
ServiceAdministratif.tarif_1_desc: Free. Scope, target format and deadline validated before any production.
ServiceAdministratif.tarif_2_desc: Price announced before production based on document type. No surprise billing along the way.
ServiceAdministratif.tarif_3_desc: If external fees are required (sworn translator, postage, large-volume printing), detailed separately.
ServiceAdministratif.cta_final_title: Specify your need, receive a quote within a few hours.
ServiceAdministratif.cta_final_subtitle: CV, letter, translation, form or printing — an advisor comes back with a clear scope, a deadline and a fixed price.
ServiceAdministratif.cta_final_wa_msg: Hello Nexus, I have an administrative document to prepare.

ServiceBillets.hero_subtitle: Multi-airline search, verified hotels, payment in CFA in Bangui, complete travel pack before departure. You explain your project, we handle the rest — cleanly, with no approximation.
ServiceBillets.hero_trust_before: Free quote · Payment in CFA · A question?
ServiceBillets.wa_question: Hello Nexus, I have a question about the Flights & hotels service.
ServiceBillets.intro_before: A plane ticket is not a standalone product. It is
ServiceBillets.intro_highlight: the central link in a journey
ServiceBillets.intro_after: where every detail counts — itinerary, hotel, assistance.
ServiceBillets.scope_subtitle: Four structured services, from booking to assistance during the trip.
ServiceBillets.scope_item1_desc: Transparent comparison of fares and constraints (stopovers, baggage, classes, change conditions).
ServiceBillets.scope_item2_desc: Accommodations matching the requested standard, near the key locations of your trip.
ServiceBillets.scope_item3_desc: Local transport recommendations, airport-hotel transfers, practical guidance.
ServiceBillets.scope_item4_desc: Schedule change notifications, intervention in case of unforeseen events during the trip.
ServiceBillets.result_subtitle: A trip organized from start to finish, with a single point of contact.
ServiceBillets.result_item1_desc: A controlled trade-off between price, duration and travel conditions.
ServiceBillets.result_item2_desc: No international wire or foreign card required.
ServiceBillets.result_item3_desc: Verified selection, customer feedback reviewed before any proposal.
ServiceBillets.result_item4_desc: You are not alone if something changes en route.
ServiceBillets.pourqui_subtitle: We work with official airlines and platforms. This transparency is part of our professional commitment.
ServiceBillets.pourqui_oui_title: This service is for people who
ServiceBillets.pourqui_oui_1: Want to entrust the search and booking of flights and/or hotels to a single point of contact in Bangui
ServiceBillets.pourqui_oui_2: Prefer to pay in CFA from Bangui rather than with an international card
ServiceBillets.pourqui_oui_3: Want a clear travel pack (e-tickets, vouchers, useful contacts) before departure
ServiceBillets.pourqui_non_title: This service is not for people who
ServiceBillets.pourqui_non_1: Expect a fare lower than the airline's official price — we do not create a parallel market
ServiceBillets.pourqui_non_2: Want to book at the very last minute on a tight period with no flexibility — anticipate when possible
ServiceBillets.pourqui_non_3: Plan to pay after the trip — a booking requires advance payment, as anywhere
ServiceBillets.metho_subtitle: From the initial brief to the final travel pack, every step is clear and tracked.
ServiceBillets.metho_01_desc: You complete our form (destination, dates, travelers, budget) or book an appointment. We understand your travel project.
ServiceBillets.metho_02_desc: Comparison across the relevant airlines (Air France, Royal Air Maroc, Ethiopian, ASKY...) and verified hotels. Quote with 2 to 3 options proposed within 24 working hours.
ServiceBillets.metho_03_desc: You validate the chosen option. Payment in CFA at the Bangui office. Immediate ticket issuance and hotel confirmations.
ServiceBillets.metho_04_desc: Delivery of the complete pack (e-tickets, vouchers, useful contacts) and support before and during the trip in case of incident.
ServiceBillets.metho_cta_subtitle: Free quote. 2 to 3 options proposed within 24 working hours.
ServiceBillets.presta_subtitle: Three services that can be ordered separately or in combination.
ServiceBillets.presta_1_desc: One-way, round-trip or multi-destination flights. Comparison across Air France, Royal Air Maroc, Ethiopian, ASKY and other relevant airlines based on the destination.
ServiceBillets.presta_2_desc: Selection on recognized platforms, choice based on budget, location and type of stay. Verification of ratings, proximity to points of interest, neighborhood safety.
ServiceBillets.presta_3_desc: Delivery of a complete pack: e-tickets, hotel vouchers, useful contacts, airport transfer guidance. The traveler leaves with everything in hand.
ServiceBillets.regions_subtitle: For destinations not listed, contact us. We handle requests case by case based on connection feasibility from Bangui.
ServiceBillets.region_europe_desc: Business travel, studies, tourism and family.
ServiceBillets.cas_title: Here is how it works in practice.
ServiceBillets.cas_1_title: Bangui → Paris, round-trip + 4 nights in a city-center hotel
ServiceBillets.cas_1_desc: Brief received Monday, 3 flight options (airline, stopovers, price) sent Wednesday with 2 hotel proposals in the business district. Validation Thursday, payment in CFA, complete pack delivered before Saturday's departure.
ServiceBillets.cas_1_result: Outcome: trip booked in 3 days, clean pack, no stress on the company side.
ServiceBillets.cas_2_desc: Search for the best flight + family hotel combination within a defined budget. Comparison across 3 platforms, hotel rating checks, selection of a central riad with a pool. Local payment, airport transfer advice included.
ServiceBillets.cas_2_result: Outcome: family departed at ease, hotel matching expectations, budget respected.
ServiceBillets.engagement_subtitle: The tickets we issue come from airlines or official platforms. Our service commission is announced upfront in the quote.
ServiceBillets.engagement_no_1: Issue tickets outside the official airline channel
ServiceBillets.engagement_no_2: Guarantee fare availability if you delay validation
ServiceBillets.engagement_no_3: Modify the refund conditions imposed by the airline
ServiceBillets.engagement_yes_1: A detailed quote with airlines, stopovers, duration and price
ServiceBillets.engagement_yes_2: 2 to 3 real options to compare, not just one pushed
ServiceBillets.engagement_yes_3: Local payment in CFA and immediate issuance after validation
ServiceBillets.engagement_yes_4: Pre- and in-trip support in case of incident
ServiceBillets.tarif_subtitle: Airline fare + Nexus commission, all in CFA, with no surprise.
ServiceBillets.tarif_1_desc: Free. 2 to 3 options proposed with airlines, duration, stopovers and exact prices.
ServiceBillets.tarif_2_desc: Official price billed by the airline, converted to CFA at the daily rate, with no hidden markup.
ServiceBillets.tarif_3_desc: Service, search, payment handling, travel pack and follow-up. Announced upfront, never adjusted afterwards.
ServiceBillets.cta_final_title: Three pieces of information are enough to start.
ServiceBillets.cta_final_subtitle: Destination, dates, travelers. The rest is built with you as the conversation unfolds.
ServiceBillets.cta_final_wa_msg: Hello Nexus, I have a question about a travel project.

ServiceChange.hero_title_end: reliable, with controlled rates and full transparency.
ServiceChange.hero_subtitle: In Bangui, we operate a manual exchange that is rigorous, transparent and secure. Daily rate announced before the transaction, verified counting, systematic receipt. No hidden margin in the displayed rate.
ServiceChange.hero_trust_before: Free quote · Daily rate announced before you travel · A question?
ServiceChange.wa_question: Hello Nexus, I have a question about the currency exchange service.
ServiceChange.intro_before: An exchange rate is not a price. It is
ServiceChange.intro_after: . The right rate announced is already half of the trust.
ServiceChange.scope_subtitle: Four steps from quote to handover of funds, at the Bangui office.
ServiceChange.scope_item1_desc: Announcement of the applicable rate before any travel, valid for the session.
ServiceChange.scope_item2_desc: Notes received are checked against banking standards (UV, patterns, security features).
ServiceChange.scope_item3_desc: Transaction carried out on site, in our secure premises, in the client's presence.
ServiceChange.scope_item4_desc: Official dated receipt with initial amount, applied rate and amount delivered.
ServiceChange.result_subtitle: Four transparency commitments. No surprise at the time of payment.
ServiceChange.result_item1_desc: The rate announced on WhatsApp is the one applied at the office.
ServiceChange.result_item2_desc: The announced rate includes everything. No commission added at the time of exchange.
ServiceChange.result_item3_desc: No informal transactions. Controlled environment, systematic checks.
ServiceChange.result_item4_desc: For your accounts, your bookkeeping or your administrative records.
ServiceChange.pourqui_subtitle: We operate strictly within the legal and regulatory framework. This transparency is part of our commitment.
ServiceChange.pourqui_oui_title: This service is for people who
ServiceChange.pourqui_oui_1: Need to exchange between CFA and foreign currencies (EUR, USD, CAD, GBP) in Bangui
ServiceChange.pourqui_oui_2: Agree to present an ID for operations above the regulatory threshold
ServiceChange.pourqui_oui_3: Want a rate clearly announced before the transaction, with no surprise
ServiceChange.pourqui_non_title: This service is not for people who
ServiceChange.pourqui_non_1: Are looking to exchange outside traceability — Nexus operates only within the legal framework
ServiceChange.pourqui_non_2: Expect a rate above the market — transparency has no magic
ServiceChange.pourqui_non_3: Want to exchange funds whose origin cannot be justified if requested
ServiceChange.metho_subtitle: From the initial quote to the receipt handover, every step is clear and tracked.
ServiceChange.metho_01_desc: You complete our form (currencies, direction, amount) or come to the office. We issue a quote with the daily rate.
ServiceChange.metho_02_desc: The announced rate is the applied rate. You receive the exact amount to be delivered before any travel, with no hidden margin.
ServiceChange.metho_03_desc: You come to our Croisement Marabena office in Bangui. For large amounts, an appointment is recommended to prepare the cash.
ServiceChange.metho_04_desc: Counting verified on both sides, cash exchange, detailed receipt issued. No hidden commission.
ServiceChange.metho_cta_subtitle: Free quote. Rate announced before you travel.
ServiceChange.devises_subtitle: For other currencies, contact us: subject to availability and procurement time.
ServiceChange.devise_eur_usages: Schengen-area travel, study fees in France, EU supplier payments.
ServiceChange.devise_usd_usages: International payments, US travel, B2B transactions in reference currency.
ServiceChange.devise_cad_usages: Study fees in Canada, travel, transfers to the Canadian diaspora.
ServiceChange.devise_gbp_usages: UK travel, operations with British partners.
ServiceChange.cadre_subtitle: Manual exchange is a regulated operation. Our rigor protects both the office and the client.
ServiceChange.cadre_1_desc: The daily rate is communicated to you before any travel to the office.
ServiceChange.cadre_2_desc: The displayed rate is the applied rate. No commission added outside the quote.
ServiceChange.cadre_3_desc: Counting of notes performed on both sides, in the client's presence.
ServiceChange.cadre_4_desc: Detailed receipt issued for every transaction, regardless of the amount.
ServiceChange.cadre_5_desc: ID required above the applicable regulatory threshold.
ServiceChange.cadre_6_desc: For very large amounts, an appointment lets us prepare the cash.
ServiceChange.cas_title: Here is how it works in practice.
ServiceChange.cas_1_title: CFA to euros for Schengen departure
ServiceChange.cas_1_desc: WhatsApp request in the morning, quote communicated in less than 30 minutes at the daily rate. Visit to the office in the afternoon, counting in front of the client, receipt issued for customs.
ServiceChange.cas_1_result: Outcome: secure cash for the trip, rate respected, customs reassured by the receipt.
ServiceChange.cas_2_title: Euros to CFA on arrival in Bangui
ServiceChange.cas_2_desc: Pre-quote sent during the trip. Appointment scheduled at the office on arrival, large amount prepared in advance, ID presented, transaction completed quickly.
ServiceChange.cas_2_result: Outcome: family supported with the right amount, stay organized without exchange hassles.
ServiceChange.engagement_subtitle: No hidden commission, no margin added at the last minute. If the market rate moves significantly between the quote and the transaction, we tell you frankly.
ServiceChange.engagement_no_1: Guarantee a rate above the actual interbank market
ServiceChange.engagement_no_3: Lock a rate long-term against market fluctuations
ServiceChange.engagement_yes_1: A daily rate clearly announced before the transaction
ServiceChange.engagement_yes_2: No hidden commission in the displayed rate
ServiceChange.engagement_yes_3: Counting verified jointly and a detailed receipt
ServiceChange.engagement_yes_4: Discretion and security for large amounts by appointment
ServiceChange.tarif_subtitle: No office fees, no added commission. Everything is included in the announced rate.
ServiceChange.tarif_1_desc: Free. Rate and exact amount to be delivered communicated before any operation.
ServiceChange.tarif_2_desc: Reassessed several times a day based on the market. Competitive on medium and large volumes.
ServiceChange.tarif_3_desc: Issued systematically. Useful for customs, accounting and traceability.
ServiceChange.cta_final_title: Request your quote with the daily rate.
ServiceChange.cta_final_subtitle: Quote within 30 minutes during business hours. Rate and exact amount communicated before any travel.
ServiceChange.cta_final_wa_msg: Hello Nexus, I have a question about an exchange operation.

ServiceTransfert.hero_title_after: secure, with fast and traceable execution.
ServiceTransfert.hero_title_end: secure, with fast and traceable execution.
ServiceTransfert.hero_subtitle: Between CAR and the rest of the world, we handle your transfers with rigor, transparency and follow-up until receipt is confirmed. Fees announced before the operation, full traceability, immediate intervention in case of incident.
ServiceTransfert.hero_trust_before: Free quote · Fees announced before the operation · A question?
ServiceTransfert.wa_question: Hello Nexus, I have a question about the Money transfer service.
ServiceTransfert.intro_before: An international transfer is not a technical operation. It is
ServiceTransfert.intro_after: between the sender, the operator and the recipient.
ServiceTransfert.scope_subtitle: Four structured steps, from initial scoping to confirmed receipt.
ServiceTransfert.scope_item1_desc: Regulatory check, validation of documents and confirmation of the procedure applicable to the corridor.
ServiceTransfert.scope_item2_desc: Selection of the operator-method pairing best suited to fees, timing and security for your case.
ServiceTransfert.scope_item3_desc: Operation carried out from our offices, fees announced before execution, supporting documents handed over.
ServiceTransfert.scope_item4_desc: Follow-up until receipt confirmed by the recipient, alert in case of anomaly.
ServiceTransfert.result_subtitle: Four concrete commitments on every operation. No hidden margin, no approximate timing.
ServiceTransfert.result_item1_desc: No fee added along the way. The quote stands.
ServiceTransfert.result_item2_desc: Supporting documents and transaction number sent for your accounts.
ServiceTransfert.result_item3_desc: Operator selected based on your time constraint.
ServiceTransfert.result_item4_desc: You know the funds have arrived, not just an assumption.
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_subtitle: We operate strictly within the legal and regulatory framework. This transparency is part of our professional commitment.
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_oui_title: This service is for people who
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_oui_1: Need to send or receive money between the CAR and abroad, with full traceability
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_oui_2: Agree to provide a valid ID to comply with regulations
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_oui_3: Are ready to confirm the recipient with their exact details (name, ID, city)
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_non_title: This service is not for people who
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_non_1: Are looking for an anonymous or untraceable channel — Nexus operates only within the legal framework
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_non_2: Want to transfer funds whose origin cannot be justified
ServiceTransfert.pourqui_non_3: Expect a rate or fees lower than what regulation allows — transparency has no magic
ServiceTransfert.metho_subtitle: From the initial quote to receipt confirmation by the recipient, every step is tracked and communicated.
ServiceTransfert.metho_01_desc: You complete our form (amount, currency, destination, recipient) or come to the office. We check regulatory feasibility.
ServiceTransfert.metho_02_desc: A Nexus advisor identifies the best channel based on destination, amount and urgency. Written quote with fees and rates announced before any commitment.
ServiceTransfert.metho_03_desc: Verification of the recipient's details, transfer executed at the office or via a secure channel. Receipt and traceability references handed over.
ServiceTransfert.metho_04_desc: We do not close the case before the recipient confirms receipt. In case of a hold, we intervene immediately with the operator.
ServiceTransfert.metho_cta_subtitle: Free quote. Fees announced before the operation.
ServiceTransfert.canaux_subtitle: Each channel has its logic: speed, cost, ceiling, destination. Our advisor recommends the one best suited to your situation, not the one that earns the office the most.
ServiceTransfert.canal_wu_desc: Fast international transfer, cash withdrawal at an authorized agent.
ServiceTransfert.canal_mobile_desc: Direct deposit to a mobile wallet (Orange Money, MTN, Airtel Money).
ServiceTransfert.canal_bank_desc: IBAN/SWIFT transfer to an international or domestic bank account.
ServiceTransfert.canal_partner_desc: Ad hoc solutions for large transfers or difficult destinations, validated by the advisor.
ServiceTransfert.cadre_subtitle: We operate in strict compliance with the BEAC, the COBAC and international anti-money-laundering rules. This rigor protects the sender, the recipient and the country.
ServiceTransfert.cadre_alert_desc: For transfers above certain thresholds, operators require additional supporting documents (origin of funds, purpose). Anticipate with your advisor.
ServiceTransfert.cadre_1_desc: For the sender and consistency with the recipient's details.
ServiceTransfert.cadre_2_desc: Supporting evidence required above certain thresholds depending on the channel.
ServiceTransfert.cadre_3_desc: Variable by channel and jurisdiction. Nexus splits or combines as needed.
ServiceTransfert.cas_title: Here is how it works in practice.
ServiceTransfert.cas_1_desc: Monthly structured remittance from France or Canada to a relative in Bangui. Channel optimized for regularity (mobile money, Western Union), receipt follow-up, archiving of receipts for traceability.

ServiceFinancement.hero_title_start: The capital that helps the right projects
ServiceFinancement.hero_subtitle: Capital + method + long-term oversight. For selected entrepreneurs, SMEs and project leaders in CAR and beyond.
ServiceFinancement.hero_wa_msg: Hello Nexus, I'd like to discuss a project with an advisor before submitting an application to the incubator.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_title: Nexus is not a bank, not a microfinance institution, not an NGO.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_subtitle: We work within a clear framework. Here is what we are not — so expectations are sharp from day one.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_1_desc: We do not provide microcredit or short-term lending. Our commitment is structural.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_2_desc: No quick returns promised, no headline multiples without due diligence. Economic discipline is our reference.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_3_desc: No commercial pressure. If your project does not fit, we say so clearly.
ServiceFinancement.nepas_4_desc: No collateral guarantee required. We assess the project, the founder and viability.
ServiceFinancement.modele_subtitle: Five complementary dimensions of a single commitment.
ServiceFinancement.modele_1_desc: Long-term commitment aligned with the project's trajectory.
ServiceFinancement.modele_2_desc: Our team works alongside the founder, not in their place.
ServiceFinancement.modele_3_desc: Capital deployed with a coherent sectoral and geographic thesis.
ServiceFinancement.modele_4_desc: Transparent sharing of outcomes under written terms.
ServiceFinancement.modele_5_desc: Capital, method, network access, monitoring: all in one.
ServiceFinancement.modes_subtitle: Depending on the project's nature and stage, our involvement takes different forms.
ServiceFinancement.mode_1_desc: Capital injection for a specific phase (launch, expansion, equipment). The remainder is co-funded or contributed by the founder.
ServiceFinancement.mode_2_desc: Full capital coverage on a project entirely validated after due diligence.
ServiceFinancement.mode_3_desc: Equity participation in an existing commercial activity with structuring potential.
ServiceFinancement.mode_4_desc: Capital and method reinforcement for an operational activity ready to reach the next stage.
ServiceFinancement.mode_5_desc: Capital + structure to open a new site, recruit, export or diversify.
ServiceFinancement.mode_6_desc: Investment in a company's long-term trajectory with shared governance.
ServiceFinancement.incub_subtitle: Our incubator addresses six types of stakeholders.
ServiceFinancement.audience_1_desc: Founders with a structured idea, a definable project and a clear horizon.
ServiceFinancement.audience_2_desc: Established commercial activities seeking to formalize, structure or scale.
ServiceFinancement.audience_3_desc: Constituted companies needing capital to reach the next operational stage.
ServiceFinancement.audience_4_desc: High-potential innovative projects rooted in the Central African or African context.
ServiceFinancement.audience_5_desc: Initiatives led by structured families with clear governance.
ServiceFinancement.audience_6_desc: Collective-impact projects with measurable economic outcomes.
ServiceFinancement.apports_subtitle: What the Nexus incubator brings beyond capital.
ServiceFinancement.metho_subtitle: From submission to long-term oversight, every step is framed and traceable.
ServiceFinancement.metho_01_desc: Structured project brief: nature, context, team, capital needs, horizon. Submitted via form or in person.
ServiceFinancement.metho_02_desc: Economic, legal and sectoral analysis. An honest written report before any commitment on our side.
ServiceFinancement.metho_03_desc: Clear agreement: amount, schedule, governance terms, outcome sharing, exit conditions.
ServiceFinancement.metho_04_desc: Periodic reporting, regular checkpoints, adjustments by mutual agreement. No passive investment.
ServiceFinancement.metho_cta_subtitle: Free initial assessment. Written feasibility report before any commitment.
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_title: Who this partnership is built for.
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_subtitle: We do not back every project. This transparency is part of our professional commitment.
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_oui_1: You are leading a structured project with clear economic objectives and an identified team
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_oui_2: You accept a written contractual framework and regular oversight
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_oui_3: You are ready to co-build the trajectory and share key indicators
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_oui_4: Your sector operates within a stable and documented legal framework
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_non_1: You are seeking immediate funding with no prior due diligence
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_non_2: You expect quick returns or guaranteed short-term profitability
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_non_3: Your project is in a sector incompatible with our ethical or regulatory criteria
ServiceFinancement.pourqui_non_4: You reject the methodical framework of support and reporting
ServiceFinancement.cas_1_title: Family commercial activity, regional expansion needed
ServiceFinancement.cas_1_desc: Distribution business operating for 8 years, seeking to open two secondary outlets. Nexus structures the expansion plan, contributes part of the capital, and supports the implementation of management controls.
ServiceFinancement.cas_1_result: Outcome: gradual rollout over 18 months, monthly indicator reviews shared across all partners.
ServiceFinancement.cas_2_desc: B2B services firm in growth phase, candidate for a major national tender. Nexus provides structuring capital (recruitment, ISO certification) and co-designs the strategic response with management.
ServiceFinancement.cas_2_result: Outcome: tender won, team doubled in 12 months, governance formalized.
ServiceFinancement.cas_3_desc: Digital platform addressing a local need, lean technical team, qualitative traction demonstrated. Nexus takes a minority stake, finances product phase 1, and connects with operational partners.
ServiceFinancement.cas_3_result: Outcome: v1 launched within 3 months, first institutional client signed at 6 months.
ServiceFinancement.engagement_subtitle: Explicit boundaries prevent misunderstandings and protect both parties.
ServiceFinancement.engagement_no_1: Guarantee a return or a quantified profitability in advance
ServiceFinancement.engagement_no_2: Commit capital without a prior written study
ServiceFinancement.engagement_no_3: Operate within an informal framework, without contract or written governance
ServiceFinancement.engagement_yes_1: A written feasibility study before any commitment
ServiceFinancement.engagement_yes_2: A clear agreement specifying amount, schedule, governance and outcome sharing
ServiceFinancement.engagement_yes_3: Long-term oversight with regular reporting and documented checkpoints
ServiceFinancement.engagement_yes_4: Full transparency on assumptions, risks and exit criteria
ServiceFinancement.cta_final_subtitle: An advisor follows up with a structured initial response.
ServiceFinancement.cta_final_wa_msg: Hello Nexus, I'd like to discuss a project for the incubator before submitting an application.
